item.title: Self-Hosted Mail Routing and Transport Management: Postfix vs Exim vs Haraka
item.description: Mail routing is the backbone of any email infrastructure. When your organization hosts multiple domains, manages subdomain-based services, or needs to route mail between internal and external systems, a well-configured mail transport layer is essential. The three most widely used self-hosted solutions for mail routing are Postfix, Exim, and Haraka — each with fundamentally different architectures and routing philosophies.

item.title: Postfix vs Exim: Best Self-Hosted Mail Transfer Agent (MTA) 2026
item.description: Choosing the right Mail Transfer Agent (MTA) is one of the most critical decisions when building a self-hosted email server. The MTA handles all incoming and outgoing mail — routing, queuing, delivery, and relay — making it the backbone of your email infrastructure.
